about: [O8 after the critic] the critic's car play (start=city, E into the car, three walkers stood in its path at 9, 14 and 20 m once it passes 32 km/h, W held), on the fix: a man's own reaction time and the freeze in the lamps - the stats at the end (hitByCar, dashes, froze)

steps.eval: (() => { const c = G.city.car, P = G.people; const f = [Math.cos(c.yaw), -Math.sin(c.yaw)]; P.dbgClear(); window.__v = [9, 14, 20].map((d, i) => P.dbgWalker(c.pos.x + f[0] * d + (i - 1) * 0.3, c.pos.z + f[1] * d, c.yaw + Math.PI / 2)); window.__minY = [9,9,9]; window.__maxY = [0,0,0]; window.__iv = setInterval(() => window.__v.forEach((p, i) => { const R = p.fig && p.fig.rag; if (R) for (const q of R.p) { window.__minY[i] = Math.min(window.__minY[i], q.y); window.__maxY[i] = Math.max(window.__maxY[i], q.y); } }), 16); return JSON.stringify({ car: [c.pos.x, c.pos.z, c.yaw], f, v: window.__v.map(p => [p.kind, +p.pos.x.toFixed(1), +p.pos.z.toFixed(1)]) }); })()

JSON.stringify({ inCar: G.city.inCar, kmh: +G.city.car.kmh.toFixed(0), car:[+G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), +G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], men: window.__v.map(p => [p.mode, !!p.down, +p.pos.x.toFixed(1), +p.pos.z.toFixed(1)]) })

JSON.stringify({ inCar: G.city.inCar, kmh: +G.city.car.kmh.toFixed(0), car:[+G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), +G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], men: window.__v.map(p => [p.mode, !!p.down, +p.pos.x.toFixed(1), +p.pos.z.toFixed(1)]) })

JSON.stringify({ inCar: G.city.inCar, kmh: +G.city.car.kmh.toFixed(0), car:[+G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), +G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], men: window.__v.map(p => [p.mode, !!p.down, +p.pos.x.toFixed(1), +p.pos.z.toFixed(1)]) })

JSON.stringify({ inCar: G.city.inCar, kmh: +G.city.car.kmh.toFixed(0), car:[+G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), +G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], men: window.__v.map(p => [p.mode, !!p.down, +p.pos.x.toFixed(1), +p.pos.z.toFixed(1)]) })

(clearInterval(window.__iv), JSON.stringify({ kmh: +G.city.car.kmh.toFixed(0), men: window.__v.map((p, i) => ({ k: p.kind, mode: p.mode, down: !!p.down, dead: !!p.dead, at: [+p.pos.x.toFixed(1), +p.pos.z.toFixed(1)], minY: +window.__minY[i].toFixed(2), maxY: +window.__maxY[i].toFixed(2), rag: !!(p.fig && p.fig.rag), asleep: p.fig && p.fig.rag ? p.fig.rag.asleep : null })), car: [+G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), +G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], stats: G.people.stats, heat: G.police.heat }))
JSON.stringify({ hitByCar: G.people.stats.hitByCar, dashes: G.people.stats.dashes, froze: G.people.stats.froze || 0, knocked: G.people.stats.knocked, killed: G.people.stats.killed })
